summary: Indian markets are shut today for Gandhi Jayanti; trading resumes Monday after four straight losing sessions left the Nifty near its lowest levels since April.

detail.leaders: IT was the only sector of note to gain on Thursday
detail.tone: The market heads into a three-day break bruised: it trimmed late losses on Thursday, but FII selling and rate-hike fears remain unresolved.
watch: Weekend crude and US-Iran Hormuz talks
FII flows when trading resumes Monday

top.title: FIIs sell ₹9,484 cr; DIIs buy ₹10,042 cr
top.line: Heavy foreign selling continued on Oct 1, with FIIs also deeply short index futures
more: FIIs hold a net short of 3,10,174 index-futures contracts
DIIs more than absorbed the cash selling (net +₹558 cr)

top.title: RBI MPC meets Mon–Wed; decision Oct 7
top.line: Inflation is at 4.82% and the rupee is past 96/$; the Governor's tone will be key
more: Rate-hike fears were cited for Thursday's sell-off
Banks, realty and autos are most sensitive to the commentary

top.title: Wall Street edges up as yields retreat
top.line: The S&P 500 rose 0.19% to 7,666.45 as Treasury yields eased from 20-year highs
more: Chip and AI stocks led the late recovery

top.title: Brent near $97 with Hormuz talks unresolved
top.line: Brent fell 1.3% to $96.76 on Oct 1, but supply is expected to stay tight through Q4
